note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week.
headline: The Houthi-Saudi war grew: a Houthi missile hit the Public Investment Fund tower in Riyadh on Nov 19, damaging several floors, with no injuries reported (#1373). The coalition says it intercepted more missiles and drones on Nov 17, 18 and 20 (#1370, #1371, #1374).
The Houthis told airlines to keep out of Saudi airspace and warned workers to leave Saudi Red Sea ports; the coalition threatened Hodeidah port in turn (#1375). No ship was attacked.

No US move against the Houthis was found: no strike, sanctions, naval action or talks. CENTCOM's commander met the Saudi crown prince in Riyadh; Reuters' sources say Trump has not agreed to US strikes and the US gives intelligence and targeting help (#1372).
No one was reported hurt in the Houthi attacks this week (#1370-#1374).
